steps.text: ime-preedit: open the inventory so JEI's ingredient overlay is up, then focus JEI's search bar the way jei-pinyin-search does (this level is creative, so the inventory bind opens the creative inventory, and Fabric's JEI key mappings read key.keyboard.unknown at runtime, so JEI's focus key is pressed directly)

ime-preedit: 26.3's client drops the first character typed after JEI's search bar takes focus (measured 2026-10-18 in jei-pinyin-search), so spend that one on a throwaway and clear the bar back to empty

ime-preedit: 组合中 (composing). A composition is not text: the search bar stays empty, the field carries a live IME pre-edit overlay, and the engine is never asked for the pinyin that is still uncommitted
ime-preedit: 提交 (committing). The committed text lands in the search bar, the pre-edit overlay goes away, and the engine really searches for what the IME committed
